title: Code-along: Add persistence with SwiftData
description: Experience SwiftData in action as we add persistence to an existing app. We’ll show you how to define your data models and seamlessly integrate persistent data with SwiftUI. You’ll also learn foundational skills for managing your app’s state using this expressive, declarative API.

codeSnippets.title: Convert Activity to a persistent model with @Model
Add Codable conformance to TripCollection
Set up model relationships between Trip, TripImage, and Activity
codeSnippets.code:
import Foundation
import SwiftData

@Model
class Trip {
    var name: String
    var collection: TripCollection

    var photo: TripImage
    var thumbnailData: Data?

    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \Activity.trip)
    var activities: [Activity] = []

    private(set) var creationDate = Date.now
    var subtitle: String?
    var isComplete: Bool = false
}
